summary: The Petitioner, Udupi Kasargode Transmission Limited, has filed the present Petition under Section 63 of the Electricity Act, 2003 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act') for adoption of transmission charges in respect of “400 kV Udupi (UPCL)-Kasargode D/C line” (hereinafter referred to as ‘the Transmission System’ or ‘Project’) to be established on Build, Own, Operate and Maintain (BOOM) basis. “ **Section 63: Determination of tariff by bidding process** : Notwithstanding anything contained in section 62, the Appropriate Commission shall adopt the tariff if such tariff has been determined through transparent process of bidding in accordance with the guidelines issued by the Central Government.” b) For procurement of transmission services, required for inter-State transmission Project, the Central Government shall notify any Central Government c) The BPC shall prepare the bid documentations in accordance with the Guidelines and obtain approval of the Appropriate Commission or alternatively, the BPC can use the Standard Bid Documents notified by the Ministry of Power. Approval of the Appropriate Commission would be necessary, if any material deviation is proposed to be made in the Standard Bid Documents. Intimation about the initiation of the bid process shall be sent by the BPC to the Appropriate Commission. d) For procurement of transmission services under the Guidelines, the BPC may adopt at its option either a two-stage process featuring separate Request for Qualification (hereinafter referred to as ‘RfQ’) and Request for Proposal (hereinafter referred to as ‘RfP’) or adopt a single stage two envelope tender process combining both RfQ and RfP processes. f) Standard documentations to be provided in the RfQ stage shall include definitions of requirements including brief description of the Project, commissioning k) The BPC shall make the final result of evaluation of all bids public.
